parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/CPUSessionAggregatorTests.swift` within the `Playback` package. Although the two methods `contextTransitionStartsNewSession` (line 186) and `sameContextTransitionDoesNothing` (line 265) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727), they are distinct test cases that verify opposite behavioral outcomes of a context transition — one asserts a new session is started, the other asserts no change occurs. Collapsing or extracting them would obscure test intent and reduce diagnostic clarity when failures occur. Structural similarity in test bodies is expected when exercising the same system under test with different inputs and assertions.
